meta.name: problem-framing
meta.description: Use when the user describes a goal but the underlying problem is unclear, or when a request feels like a premature solution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把模糊目标梳理成清晰问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常收到模糊需求却不知从哪儿开始
copy.tagline_en: Clarify the real problem behind vague goals.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often receive ambiguous requests and need to uncover the underlying issues.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你把模糊的请求转化为清晰的问题陈述。它会先复述你的请求并确认，然后询问目标用户、任务和障碍，识别隐藏假设，最后提供 2-3 种问题视角供你选择，并总结一句可确认的问题陈述。
howto.when: 当你描述了一个目标但根本问题不明确，或者你的请求听起来像是一个过早的解决方案时，Claude 会主动触发此技能来帮你理清问题。

say.text: 我想提高销售额，但不确定怎么入手。
say.note: Claude 会帮你理清真正的问题并重构目标。

say.text: 我们团队需要一个新的项目管理工具。
say.note: Claude 会质疑这是过早的方案，引导你定义问题。

say.text: 帮我分析一下网站跳出率高的原因。
say.note: Claude 会询问用户、目标和障碍，重构问题。

howto.what_en: Claude will help you turn a fuzzy request into a clear problem statement. It restates your request for confirmation, asks about the user, goal, and obstacle, identifies hidden assumptions, offers 2-3 problem framings, and then states the chosen framing back as a confirmable sentence.
howto.when_en: When you describe a goal but the underlying problem is unclear, or when your request feels like a premature solution, Claude triggers this skill to clarify the problem before proceeding.

say_en.text: I want to increase sales, but I'm not sure how to start.
say_en.note: Claude helps uncover the real problem and reframe the goal.

say_en.text: Our team needs a new project management tool.
say_en.note: Claude challenges this as a premature solution and guides problem definition.

say_en.text: Help me analyze why our website bounce rate is high.
say_en.note: Claude asks about users, goals, and obstacles to reframe the problem.
